hints.title: Simulate Rays from the King Position
hints.text: Rather than testing all queens, cast rays outward from the king along the eight cardinal and diagonal directions.

hints.title: Identify First Obstacle in Each Direction
hints.text: Store queen coordinates in a set for instant presence verification along each step.

hints.title: Halt Ray upon First Queen Found
hints.text: When a queen is encountered along a direction ray, add her coordinates to output and stop extending that ray.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise testing of angles and intervening blockers between all queens is verbose and error-prone.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stepping outward from the king traverses at most 64 board squares in total.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that outward rays from the king find directly attacking queens in constant time.
complexity.notes: Chessboard dimensions are fixed at 8 by 8.
